0022600029.text: The Grizzlies host the Oklahoma City Thunder in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group B game, Memphis's 9th of the season, with both teams at 6-2. Memphis is 2-2 at home and 4-0 on the road, has lost its last two games, and sits 3rd in the Southwest, 0.5 games back, while Oklahoma City has won its last two, is 4-0 at home, and sits 2nd in the Northwest, 0.5 games back. Memphis is without Scotty Pippen Jr. (out, back soreness) and Isaiah Stewart (day-to-day, knee, game-time decision), and Oklahoma City is without Cason Wallace (out, shoulder surgery), Chet Holmgren (out, knee), Jalen Williams (out, leg fracture), Jaylin Williams (out, back spasms), Nikola Topic (out, back), and Thomas Sorber (out, knee). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though the Grizzlies lost all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently a 117-116 loss in Memphis on January 9, 2026.
